$comment: $id is a logical identifier only — this URL is not currently resolvable. Validators that dereference $id as a network URI should treat 404 as non-fatal.
title: agentbootup Environment Config (env-config v0.1)
description: Schema for <env>-env.json files consumed by `agentbootup mount --env-config <path>`. Implements DEC-024 per-environment approval semantics.

schema_version.description: Schema version identifier. Current: "0.1". agentbootup rejects configs where the major version is unknown or greater than supported.

environment.description: Short kebab-case identifier for this environment. Used in log output, mount.json, and status reporting.

brain_allowlist.description: Brain IDs permitted to mount in this environment. Must be explicitly declared — omitting is a hard error. An empty array means no brains are permitted.

environment_skills.description: Environment-specific skill layer overlaid on top of core + brain skills at mount time (DEC-002 three-layer composition).

path.description: Path to environment-specific skills directory, relative to the env config file's location.

optional.description: If false: path not existing is a hard error — mount fails. If true: path not existing produces a warning and the layer is skipped. Default: false. Use optional:true only for genuinely optional capability layers.

local_tools_path.description: Path to local tools available in this environment. null or omitted = no local tools. Reserved field in v1: read and stored in mount.json but not acted on. Phase 4+.

secret_source.description: How environment-level secrets are injected at mount time. Additive to Phase 1b brain-level secrets.

provider.description: Secret provider. Only "mech-vault" is supported in v1.

namespace.description: Vault namespace to read from. Mixed case allowed (^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$): vault namespace strings can contain uppercase letters (e.g. production values may differ from kebab-case env names). This is intentional and differs from the lowercase-only patterns used for environment and brain IDs.

routing_target.description: Where messages sent to a mounted brain are routed.

provider.description: Routing provider. Only "mech-plane" is supported in v1.

endpoint.description: Base URL of the mech-plane instance.

approval_mode.description: Approval mode passed as approvalMode to POST /orchestrate.

approval_flow.description: How tool call approvals are handled for sessions spawned in this environment. Drives agentbootup hook policy at mount time (DEC-024). Mechanism-inapplicable fields are rejected so the frozen approval contract reaches runtime without smuggled bypass data.

mechanism.description: "mech-plane": agentbootup strips PermissionRequest hooks from settings; mech-plane onToolCall gate is canonical. "teleporter_hook": hooks remain; TELEPORTATION_PARENT_SESSION_ID must be set or mount hard-fails.

endpoint.description: Approval endpoint. Required when mechanism is "mech-plane".

parent_session_id_var.description: Env var name to check at mount time. Required when mechanism is "teleporter_hook".
